FAQ

And the newcomer in trade will be able to understand this?

We made the app primarily for beginners, providing the safest and easiest way to understand the world of crypto-trading. All actions - a repetition of deals for professionals in 2 cliques.

With what amount on the deposit
is it best to start?

$10 minimum deposit limit. But we recommend $100 not to miss the most successful deals on expensive coins and diversify your portfolio.

What risks am I taking?

We have implemented default risk management and cash management. With each transaction you will not be able to lose more than 2% of the deposit. Each successful deal closes at +5%-20%. Following traders with high reputation profitability you can be in stable plus.

How much time do you need to spend on trading to earn?

One hour a month. On average, our clients conclude 50 deals per month, where 10 deals are copied independently by a professional, and the rest through automatic repetition without personal participation.

If a professional starts trading in minus, what will happen to my deposit?

You can at any time disable the pursuit of the unprofitable trader. By making one swipe. you will find a new one that trades in the plus. The smart feed shows the most effective traders at the moment.

Big market players will trade against trader to make him and me lose money?

There are several thousand successful traders on the app. In order not to risk, it is better to connect copying transactions for several and then you reduce the risk not only on the trading strategy of a particular trader, but also on the transactions themselves. You will not lose more than 2% of the deposit per transaction.
